notes.title: Great improvements coming to next update !
notes.notes:
We have been doing some work on the game as we wanted to bring some improvements !

* the new engine, and improvements to clutch and tire physics should bring a new and exciting slides
* the car list has changed. We have added some more exciting cars
* we are also working on a couple more free drift areas

* Online Multiplayer mode will most likely come in v1.8.0 in case we wont manage to implement it in v1.7.0

notes.title: Drift in Freeroam mode
notes.notes:
In update 1.6 a free roam mode is added.

There is one area initially including a set of 15 small sub events/challenges.
Complete all events and get rewarded. Raise level and unlock cars !

notes.title: Adding Free Roam mode in next update !
notes.notes:
In next update Free Roam mode should be added !

Some notes:

* This will be a mode where you drift in some area and complete stunts and play free roam events. When you complete the requirements, the free roam area will be considered completed and players will be rewarded.

* In this upcoming update, buying and upgrading vehicles may get back into the game in order for the free roam mode plus earning XP point and credits to make some sense !

* The free roam is designed in a way where there might be added more areas with game updates instead of creating one big open world area ! Areas will however be not that small !

Cheers !

notes.title: Some great improvements are coming !
notes.notes:
Hi, just to share a couple of things:

* a new more accurate engine model has been implemented
* also working on differential implementations like Limited Slip and Locking diffs which also improves the engine torque distribution on both left and right wheels for drifting
* A couple of camera settings should be added as well that will allow players to control how much camera lags behind the vehicle for example.
* Also a new setting will be added that can affect the vehicle response to forces, for example it can be set so it reacts really quickly or a bit slower which is more realistic

What else might also get into next update is:

* ackerman, toe, caster settings for the steering
* A drift helper may be introduced in some way
* A new open area level may get into next update as well

That's for now !
Cheers !

notes.title: Update v1.5.0
notes.notes:
JDI v1.5.0 is here with a few fixes and optimizations

IMPROVED :
* Cars are a bit more responsive and easier to control
* Exhaust audio and visuals are improved
* New tire texture
* Challenges target scores are lowered

FIXED :
* Tire side slip values are a bit mode accurate now
* Brake lights were not working due to shader change
* Normal maps on tire rims were not visible
* Some leaderboards were not updated
* Current player position in leaderboard was not loaded on challenge complete
* Minimap on Main Track level was not visible
* Music and Ambient audio sliders couldn't be changed using mouse

* Some more internal fixes and improvements

notes.title: JDI officially released !
notes.notes:
JDI is officially released now with v1.4.0

notes.title: V1.3.0 unlocked levels and upgraded cars
notes.notes:
Hey dear drifters, the third update is released. Here is what's been done:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35812799/1f51fb58defacc30899b374145602161193c85a5.png[/img]

WHAT'S NEW AND CHANGED
[list]
[*] Overall game refactoring
[*] All cars are now fully upgraded and drift ready
[*] All levels are now initially unlocked
[*] High speed steer assistance is added. An option in available in settings
[*] A gas cutout option has been added to the settings. Disable if you don't like how the engine cuts the gas
[*]  Car reset option is added. Initially binded to "R" key
[*] A replay system is implemented. All events which are based on tracks can play reviewed by the replay system
[*] A ghost system is implemented as well. It will record your best performance based on scoring and next time when you play the same level, the ghost car will be visible as well. An option for toggling ghost car is available in setting
[*] Also, levels are refactored and re-grouped by regions. Some are removed and one new level is added "Downhill Slide"
[*] 10 rim models are now available. Every car has the option to unlock a rim
[*] Max steering angle is increased to 70 degrees when counter steering. The steering angle when driving is locked to 40 degrees
[*] Upgrades are disabled to remove the complication and help you get faster in drifting
[*] The drift score now only depends on drifting but the multiplier now depends on high drift angle and higher drift speeds. The UI is also refactored
[*] Drift assistance was further improved
[*] Added car weight distribution option in Tune Manager to allow you shift the weight a little to fine tune drifting if needed
[*] Audio Player : there is a new button in the audio player which when pressed, will open the text file to edit directories containing music. Also there is a regenerate list button which will regenerate the list of songs after the text file is altered
[*] New "High Drift" camera is added. All camera modes are visible by pressing the "B" button
[*] XP point are now ignored in gameplay as they do not serve in unlocking stuff anymore, however they are still calculated in the background in case they need to get back in the game at some point
[*] New leaderboards are created for the new levels
[/list]

notes.title: JDI update 2 is now live !
notes.notes:
The second update of JDI  is now live !

New

* Painting car parts - car body, rims, rims spokes and calipers
* New nicer default color combinations for all cars
* New and better in game cameras plus camera manager - use key "B" to toggle menu in game
* Audio player key bind is added. Use now key "M" on keyboard to open player in game
* New level based on completing laps, based on Challenge 5 is added
* Added rear wings to second and third vehicle

Improved

* Auto counter steer helper is improved and now recommended to enable, for nicer drifts
* First car upgrades required level is lowered, to let players upgrade it quickly
* Screen space reflection option in game settings in now enabled. Use to toggle on/off SSR

notes.title: First update of JDI is now available !
notes.notes:
Hi to all. The first update of JDI is here. This is what's new and improved:

New:

[list]
[*] In game audio player to play local mp3 and wav files located on HDD ( check in game info )
[*] Car upgrades
[*] Two more cars added
[*] New challenge ( more to come later )
[*] Turbo sound and exhaust effects
[*] Choose KM/h or MP/h from the settings
[/list]

Improved/Fixed:

[list]
[*] Automatic gearing is now set as default
[*] Car slide at zero speed in forward direction is fully eliminated ( still side slides a little )
[*] UI improvements
[*] Leaderboard window can show top 20, entries around player and friends list
[*] Tune sliders have been improved and some tune info has been added
[*] Player level has been increased to 30
[*] Spawning sparkles from scratching
[*] New Speedometer design
[*] New loading screen
[*] Fixed audio glitches in menus
[/list]
